annotation_source: Agent-assisted engineering requirements, authored separately from response fixtures; not independently human-reviewed.
split_policy: Split by the combination field; no combination crosses dev/holdout. This small public suite is regression coverage, not a hidden test distribution.
offline_policy: Independent scripted requirements, audits, and candidate plans exercise production phases; each policy consumes only its own phases. Fixtures measure execution and evaluation, never LLM ability. Observation scenarios hold private world values and faults outside model input.
